title: A great interview with Diana Butler Bass
excerpt: Especially interesting is to hear Diana contrast her analysis of recent religious demographic data with that of Russ Douthat in his book “Bad Religion” (where, it turns out, I am briefly associated, with my friend Rob Bell, ambiguously between good and bad …)
